body.headline: NATIONAL PHILANTHROPIC TRUST AND J.P. MORGAN ENABLE NEW PATHWAY FOR DAF GIVING TO CHILDREN'S INVESTMENT ACCOUNTS
body.summary: National Philanthropic Trust (NPT), one of the nation's largest public charities and a leading independent sponsor of donor-advised funds (DAFs), and the J.P. Morgan Charitable Giving Fund program today announced that, at the request of a donor, it worked with the Treasury Department to offer a new pathway enabling DAF donors to support qualified contributions to Trump Accounts, leveraging philanthropic capital to help young people build assets for their futures.
